_about: Native methylation simulator presets (simulate_methylation(engine = 'native')). Cytosines sit in regions (blocks) of one chromatin state; each state has a methylation level per sequence context. Values are typical genome-wide levels, used when no template of the species exists. Plant levels follow Arabidopsis/maize methylomes (high CG/CHG/CHH in transposons and heterochromatin, CG-only gene-body methylation, unmethylated euchromatin); mammal levels follow somatic tissues (most CpGs methylated, CpG islands unmethylated).
